newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures close mixed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures close mixed in light trade.

text.p: Feb 21 - U.S. stock index futures closed mixed, as the market continued to consolidate. Traders said the expiration of equity index options kept activity quiet. March S&Ps held slim gains after failing to find sellers at the one-week low of 801.80. March Nikkeis expanded gains, rising to 19,255.
